solutions.method: Interpret the line in its stated prediction direction and recognise the special exact pattern in this table.

steps.explanation: 3 g is the predicted mass at birth(t=0);4.5 g/day is the predicted daily increase.
30 days is outside the observed 1–10 day range. Growth need not remain linear that long, so this is unreliable extrapolation.

In general, regression of mass on age is designed to predict mass, and reversing it is not the same as fitting age on mass. However, this particular table lies exactly on x=3+4.5 t, so its inverse gives the same perfect linear fit:

Thus the supplied blanket objection to inversion has an exception for the exact data printed here; for real noisy observations, use the regression in the required direction.
